# ------------------------------------------------------------------ name mapping
def _hex_upper(text: str) -> str:
    return text.upper()


def map_identifier(
    name: str,
    known: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
) -> Tuple[str, bool, Optional[str]]:
    """Map one Ghidra identifier to a readable C identifier.

    Returns ``(new_name, changed, origin)`` where ``origin`` is the original
    name when it differs, so callers can keep it in a comment.
    """
    if known is not None and name in known:
        new = known[name]
        return new, new != name, (name if new != name else None)

    if name.startswith("FUN_CODE_"):
        new = "sub_" + _hex_upper(name[len("FUN_CODE_"):])
    elif name.startswith("thunk_FUN_CODE_"):
        new = "sub_" + _hex_upper(name[len("thunk_FUN_CODE_"):]) + "_thunk"
    elif name.startswith("UNK_CODE_"):
        new = "unk_code_" + _hex_upper(name[len("UNK_CODE_"):])
    elif name.startswith("LAB_CODE_") or name.startswith("code_c0x"):
        new = "loc_" + _hex_upper(name.split("_")[-1])
    elif name.startswith("DAT_INTMEM_"):
        new = "iram_" + _hex_upper(name[len("DAT_INTMEM_"):])
    elif name.startswith("DAT_EXTMEM_"):
        new = "xdata_" + _hex_upper(name[len("DAT_EXTMEM_"):])
    elif name.startswith("DAT_SFR_"):
        new = "sfr_" + _hex_upper(name[len("DAT_SFR_"):])
    elif name.startswith("UNK_SFR_"):
        new = "sfr_" + _hex_upper(name[len("UNK_SFR_"):])
    elif name.startswith("DAT_CODE_"):
        new = "rom_" + _hex_upper(name[len("DAT_CODE_"):])
    elif name.startswith("DAT_"):
        new = "unk_" + name[len("DAT_"):]
    elif name.startswith("func_0x"):
        addr = int(name[len("func_0x"):], 16)
        new = "sub_%04X_external" % addr
    elif re.fullmatch(r"_[0-9a-fA-F]+_[0-7]", name):
        head, _, bit = name[1:].partition("_")
        byte = int(head, 16)
        new = "bit_%02X_%s" % (byte, bit)
    elif re.fullmatch(r"bINTMEM[0-9a-fA-F]+", name):
        new = "bit_iram_" + _hex_upper(name[len("bINTMEM"):])
    elif re.fullmatch(r"b[A-Za-z]+[0-9a-fA-F]+", name) and name.startswith("b"):
        new = "bit_" + name[1:]
    else:
        return name, False, None

    return new, new != name, (name if new != name else None)


def rename_identifier(name: str, mapping: Dict[str, str]) -> str:
    """Return the replacement for ``name``, honouring a pre-computed mapping."""
    if name in mapping:
        return mapping[name]
    new, changed, _origin = map_identifier(name)
    return new if changed else name


# -------------------------------------------------------------------------- text
_STRING_OR_CHAR = re.compile(r'"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"|\'(?:\\.|[^\'\\])*\'', re.S)


def rewrite_identifiers(text: str, mapping: Dict[str, str]) -> str:
    """Rewrite identifiers in ``text``, leaving string/char literals untouched."""
    out: List[str] = []
    pos = 0
    for match in re.finditer(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*", text):
        # skip identifiers inside string/char literals
        literal = _STRING_OR_CHAR.search(text, pos)
        while literal is not None and literal.start() < match.start():
            if literal.end() > match.start():
                break
            pos = literal.end()
            literal = _STRING_OR_CHAR.search(text, pos)
        if literal is not None and literal.start() <= match.start() < literal.end():
            continue
        out.append(text[pos:match.start()])
        name = match.group()
        if name in _C_KEYWORDS:
            out.append(name)
        else:
            new, changed, _origin = map_identifier(name)
            out.append(new if changed else name)
        pos = match.end()
    out.append(text[pos:])
    return "".join(out)


def _strip_line_comments(text: str) -> str:
    return "\n".join(re.sub(r"//[^\n]*", "", line) for line in text.splitlines())


def _normalise_newlines(text: str) -> str:
    return text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")


def pretty_body(text: str) -> str:
    """Tidy a body for a generated file without changing any token."""
    text = _normalise_newlines(text)
    lines = [line.rstrip() for line in text.splitlines()]
    while lines and not lines[0].strip():
        lines.pop(0)
    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
        lines.pop()
    # collapse runs of blank lines and over-indent from the original nesting
    result: List[str] = []
    blanks = 0
    for line in lines:
        if not line.strip():
            blanks += 1
            if blanks > 1:
                continue
        else:
            blanks = 0
        result.append(line)
    # dedent by the common indentation of non-empty lines
    indents = [len(l) - len(l.lstrip(" ")) for l in result if l.strip()]
    if indents:
        common = min(indents)
        if common:
            result = [(l[common:] if l.strip() else l) for l in result]
    return "\n".join(result)


def check_balance(text: str) -> List[str]:
    """Cheap C sanity check: brace/paren/bracket balance outside literals.

    Returns a list of human-readable problems; an empty list means balanced.
    This is deliberately *not* a compiler: it catches truncation and mangled
    emission, which is the realistic failure mode for generated C.
    """
    problems: List[str] = []
    stack: List[Tuple[str, int]] = []
    pairs = {")": "(", "]": "[", "}": "{"}
    line = 1
    i = 0
    n = len(text)
    while i < n:
        ch = text[i]
        if ch == "\n":
            line += 1
            i += 1
            continue
        if ch == "/" and i + 1 < n and text[i + 1] == "/":
            j = text.find("\n", i)
            i = n if j < 0 else j
            continue
        if ch == "/" and i + 1 < n and text[i + 1] == "*":
            j = text.find("*/", i + 2)
            if j < 0:
                problems.append(f"line {line}: unterminated block comment")
                break
            line += text.count("\n", i, j)
            i = j + 2
            continue
        if ch in "\"'":
            quote = ch
            i += 1
            while i < n and text[i] != quote:
                if text[i] == "\\":
                    i += 1
                if i < n and text[i] == "\n":
                    line += 1
                i += 1
            if i >= n:
                problems.append(f"line {line}: unterminated literal")
                break
            i += 1
            continue
        if ch in "([{":
            stack.append((ch, line))
        elif ch in ")]}":
            if not stack:
                problems.append(f"line {line}: unmatched {ch!r}")
            elif stack[-1][0] != pairs[ch]:
                problems.append(
                    f"line {line}: {ch!r} closes {stack[-1][0]!r} opened on line {stack[-1][1]}"
                )
                stack.pop()
            else:
                stack.pop()
        i += 1
    for opener, opened_at in stack:
        problems.append(f"line {opened_at}: unclosed {opener!r}")
    return problems


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ dump indexing
@dataclass
class RawFunction:
    """A function definition found directly in the text of the dump."""

    name: str
    return_type: str
    params: str
    body: str
    line: int
    address: Optional[int] = None


_RAW_SIG_RE = re.compile(
    r"^\s*(?P<ret>(?:unsigned\s+|signed\s+)?[A-Za-z_]\w*(?:\s*\*+)?)\s+"
    r"(?P<name>[A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\((?P<params>[^;{}]*)\)\s*$",
    re.M,
)


def _extract_braces(code: str, brace_index: int) -> Optional[str]:
    """Return the body of the block starting at ``brace_index``."""
    depth = 0
    i = brace_index
    n = len(code)
    while i < n:
        ch = code[i]
        if ch == '"':
            i += 1
            while i < n and code[i] != '"':
                i += 2 if code[i] == "\\" else 1
        elif ch == "'":
            i += 1
            while i < n and code[i] != "'":
                i += 2 if code[i] == "\\" else 1
        elif ch == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif ch == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return code[brace_index + 1:i]
        i += 1
    return None


def scan_raw_functions(text: str) -> List[RawFunction]:
    """Find every function definition in the dump text, including ones with
    pointer return types that the layout heuristic in :mod:`recover.parse`
    skips."""
    code = _strip_line_comments(_normalise_newlines(text))
    lines = code.splitlines()
    offsets: List[int] = []
    running = 0
    for line in lines:
        offsets.append(running)
        running += len(line) + 1

    found: List[RawFunction] = []
    for index, line in enumerate(lines):
        match = _RAW_SIG_RE.match(line)
        if not match:
            continue
        ret = match.group("ret").strip()
        if ret.split()[0] not in _TYPE_WORDS:
            continue
        name = match.group("name")
        if name in _C_KEYWORDS:
            continue
        j = index + 1
        blanks = 0
        while j < len(lines) and not lines[j].strip():
            j += 1
            blanks += 1
        if blanks > 3 or j >= len(lines) or lines[j].strip() != "{":
            continue
        brace_index = offsets[j] + lines[j].index("{")
        body = _extract_braces(code, brace_index)
        if body is None:
            continue
        address = None
        if name.startswith("FUN_CODE_"):
            try:
                address = int(name.split("_")[-1], 16)
            except ValueError:
                address = None
        found.append(RawFunction(name, ret, match.group("params").strip(), body, index + 1, address))
    return found


def missing_ranges(
    covered: Sequence[Tuple[int, int]] = ((DUMP_ROM_START, DUMP_ROM_END),),
    total_start: int = 0x0000,
    total_end: int = 0xFFFF,
) -> List[List[int]]:
    """Complement of ``covered`` within ``total_start..total_end``."""
    gaps: List[List[int]] = []
    cursor = total_start
    for start, end in sorted(covered):
        if start > cursor:
            gaps.append([cursor, start - 1])
        cursor = max(cursor, end + 1)
    if cursor <= total_end:
        gaps.append([cursor, total_end])
    return gaps


@dataclass
class DumpFacts:
    """Everything the emitters need to know about one dump."""

    program: Program
    source_name: str
    covered: List[Tuple[int, int]] = field(default_factory=list)
    parsed_names: set = field(default_factory=set)
    raw_functions: List[RawFunction] = field(default_factory=list)
    raw_only: List[RawFunction] = field(default_factory=list)
    called_names: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    uncovered_calls: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    intrinsic_uses: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)


_CALL_RE = re.compile(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\(")


def collect_intrinsics(text: str) -> Dict[str, int]:
    """How often each decompiler intrinsic appears in ``text``."""
    counts: Dict[str, int] = {}
    for match in INTRINSIC_RE.finditer(text):
        counts[match.group(1)] = counts.get(match.group(1), 0) + 1
    return counts


def _analyse(
    text: str,
    source_name: str,
    covered: Sequence[Tuple[int, int]] = ((DUMP_ROM_START, DUMP_ROM_END),),
) -> DumpFacts:
    program = parse_dump(text, source_name)
    facts = DumpFacts(program=program, source_name=source_name, covered=list(covered))
    facts.parsed_names = {f.name for f in program.functions}
    facts.raw_functions = scan_raw_functions(text)
    facts.raw_only = [r for r in facts.raw_functions if r.name not in facts.parsed_names]

    for fn in program.functions:
        for match in _CALL_RE.finditer(fn.body):
            facts.called_names[match.group(1)] = facts.called_names.get(match.group(1), 0) + 1
    for raw in facts.raw_only:
        for match in _CALL_RE.finditer(raw.body):
            facts.called_names[match.group(1)] = facts.called_names.get(match.group(1), 0) + 1

    known = facts.parsed_names | {r.name for r in facts.raw_functions} | set(_C_KEYWORDS)
    defined = facts.parsed_names | {r.name for r in facts.raw_functions}

    def covered_addr(addr: int) -> bool:
        return any(start <= addr <= end for start, end in facts.covered)

    for name, count in facts.called_names.items():
        if name in known:
            continue
        if INTRINSIC_RE.fullmatch(name) or name in INTRINSIC_ARITY:
            continue
        if name in ("decimal_adjust",):
            facts.uncovered_calls[name] = count
            continue
        if name.startswith("func_0x"):
            addr = int(name[len("func_0x"):], 16)
            if not covered_addr(addr):
                facts.uncovered_calls[name] = count
            continue
        # a plain name we have no definition for: report it as unresolved
        facts.uncovered_calls[name] = count

    facts.uncovered_calls = {
        k: v for k, v in facts.uncovered_calls.items() if k not in defined
    }
    for fn in program.functions:
        for name, count in collect_intrinsics(fn.body).items():
            facts.intrinsic_uses[name] = facts.intrinsic_uses.get(name, 0) + count
    for raw in facts.raw_only:
        for name, count in collect_intrinsics(raw.body).items():
            facts.intrinsic_uses[name] = facts.intrinsic_uses.get(name, 0) + count
    return facts


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ C emitter
@dataclass
class EmitResult:
    """One generated artifact."""

    path: str
    text: str
    stats: Dict[str, object] = field(default_factory=dict)
    balance: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)


def _c_declaration(decl: Global, name_map: Dict[str, str]) -> str:
    """Emit one global declaration in C."""
    if decl.type == "typedef":
        return decl.raw
    if decl.is_bit:
        new, _changed, origin = map_identifier(decl.name)
        note = "" if origin is None else f"  /* was {decl.name!r} */"
        return f"/* bit cell {decl.name} */ unsigned char {new};{note}"
    new = name_map.get(decl.name)
    if new is None:
        new, _changed, _origin = map_identifier(decl.name)
    ctype = TYPE_MAP.get(decl.type, decl.type)
    stars = decl.stars or ""
    array = decl.array or ""
    comment = ""
    if ctype != decl.type:
        comment = f"   /* {decl.type} in the Ghidra dump */"
    if decl.type == "undefined":
        return f"unsigned char {new}{array};{comment}"
    return f"{ctype} {stars}{new}{array};{comment}"


def _c_signature(func: Function, name_map: Dict[str, str]) -> Tuple[str, List[str]]:
    """Build ``ret name(params)`` plus the list of renamed things."""
    notes: List[str] = []
    new_name = name_map.get(func.name)
    if new_name is None:
        new_name, changed, origin = map_identifier(func.name)
        if changed and origin:
            notes.append(origin)
    ret = TYPE_MAP.get(func.return_type, func.return_type)
    if ret != func.return_type:
        notes.append(func.return_type)
    params = []
    for param in func.params:
        params.append(rewrite_identifiers(param, name_map))
    return f"{ret} {new_name}({', '.join(params) if params else 'void'})", notes


def _macro_for_intrinsic(name: str) -> str:
    """One ``#define`` reproducing Ghidra's semantics for ``name``."""
    arity = INTRINSIC_ARITY.get(name, 0)
    if name == "halt_baddata":
        return "#define halt_baddata() __baddata()"
    if name == "nop":
        return "#define nop() ((void)0)"
    match = re.fullmatch(r"ZEXT(\d)(\d)", name)
    if match:
        width = int(match.group(1)) * int(match.group(2))
        return f"#define {name}(x) ((unsigned int)((x) & 0x{((1 << width) - 1):X}))"
    match = re.fullmatch(r"SEXT(\d)(\d)", name)
    if match:
        width = int(match.group(1)) * int(match.group(2))
        return (
            f"#define {name}(x) ((int)(((unsigned int)(x) & 0x{((1 << width) - 1):X}u) ^ "
            f"0x{((1 << (width - 1))):X}u) - 0x{((1 << (width - 1))):X})"
        )
    match = re.fullmatch(r"SUB(\d)(\d)", name)
    if match:
        out_bits, in_bits = int(match.group(1)), int(match.group(2))
        mask = (1 << (in_bits * 8)) - 1
        if out_bits == 1:
            return f"#define {name}(x, s) ((unsigned char)(((unsigned int)(x) >> (s)) & 0x{mask:X}))"
        width = out_bits * 8
        return (
            f"#define {name}(x, s) ((unsigned int)(((unsigned int)(x) >> (s)) & 0x{((1 << width) - 1):X}))"
        )
    if name == "CARRY1":
        return "#define CARRY1(a, b) ((unsigned char)((((unsigned int)((a) & 0xFF) + ((b) & 0xFF)) > 0xFF) ? 1 : 0))"
    if name == "CARRY2":
        return "#define CARRY2(a, b) ((unsigned char)((((unsigned long)((a) & 0xFFFF) + ((b) & 0xFFFF)) > 0xFFFF) ? 1 : 0))"
    if name == "SCARRY1":
        return (
            "#define SCARRY1(a, b) ((unsigned char)(((((signed int)(signed char)(a)) + "
            "((signed int)(signed char)(b))) > 127 || (((signed int)(signed char)(a)) + "
            "((signed int)(signed char)(b))) < -128) ? 1 : 0))"
        )
    if name.startswith("SBORROW"):
        width = 8 if name.endswith("1") else (16 if name.endswith("2") else 32)
        return (
            f"#define {name}(a, b) ((unsigned char)((((signed long)((a) & 0x{((1 << width) - 1):X})) - "
            f"((signed long)((b) & 0x{((1 << width) - 1):X}))) < 0 ? 1 : 0))"
        )
    match = re.fullmatch(r"CONCAT(\d)(\d)", name)
    if match:
        high_bits, low_bits = int(match.group(1)) * 8, int(match.group(2)) * 8
        return (
            f"#define {name}(hi, lo) ((unsigned int)((((unsigned int)((hi) & 0x{((1 << high_bits) - 1):X})) "
            f"<< {low_bits}) | ((unsigned int)((lo) & 0x{((1 << low_bits) - 1):X}))))"
        )
    if arity == 0:
        return f"#define {name}() ((void)0)"
    if arity == 1:
        return f"#define {name}(x) ((unsigned int)(x))"
    return f"#define {name}(a, b) ((unsigned int)((a) ^ (b)))"


_UNDECLARED_PARAM_RE = re.compile(r"(?P<name>[A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\[(?P<len>\d+)\]")


def _arg_count(facts: DumpFacts, callee: str) -> int:
    """Maximum argument count with which ``callee`` is actually called."""
    best = 0
    sources = [f.body for f in facts.program.functions] + [r.body for r in facts.raw_only]
    for body in sources:
        for match in re.finditer(r"\b" + re.escape(callee) + r"\s*\(", body):
            index = match.end()
            depth = 1
            count = 0
            seen = False
            while index < len(body) and depth > 0:
                ch = body[index]
                if ch in "([{":
                    depth += 1
                elif ch in ")]}":
                    depth -= 1
                    if depth == 0:
                        break
                elif ch == "," and depth == 1:
                    count += 1
                elif not ch.isspace() and depth == 1:
                    seen = True
                index += 1
            total = count + 1 if seen else 0
            best = max(best, total)
    return best


class CProgram:
    """Builds the readable C reconstruction of one dump."""

    def __init__(self, facts: DumpFacts, source_path: str = "") -> None:
        self.facts = facts
        self.source_path = source_path or facts.source_name
        self.name_map: Dict[str, str] = {}
        self.globals: Dict[str, str] = {}
        self.undefined_globals: Dict[str, str] = {}
        self.label_names: set = set()

    # -------------------------------------------------------------- collection
    def _collect(self) -> None:
        facts = self.facts
        for decl in facts.program.globals:
            if not decl.name:
                continue
            new, changed, _origin = map_identifier(decl.name)
            self.name_map[decl.name] = new
            if changed:
                LEGACY_RENAME[decl.name] = new
        for func in facts.program.functions:
            new, _changed, _origin = map_identifier(func.name)
            self.name_map[func.name] = new
        for raw in facts.raw_only:
            new, _changed, _origin = map_identifier(raw.name)
            self.name_map[raw.name] = new
        for callee in facts.uncovered_calls:
            new, _changed, _origin = map_identifier(callee)
            self.name_map[callee] = new
        # undefined globals: identifiers used in a body that no declaration covers
        for func in facts.program.functions:
            self._collect_undeclared(func.body)
        for raw in facts.raw_only:
            self._collect_undeclared(raw.body)
        # labels must not collide with globals
        for func in facts.program.functions:
            for label in func.labels:
                self.label_names.add(map_identifier(label)[0])
            for match in re.finditer(r"\b(?:goto\s+)([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*;", func.body):
                self.label_names.add(map_identifier(match.group(1))[0])
        for raw in facts.raw_only:
            for match in re.finditer(r"^\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*:", raw.body, re.M):
                self.label_names.add(map_identifier(match.group(1))[0])

    def _collect_undeclared(self, body: str) -> None:
        functions = self.facts.parsed_names | {r.name for r in self.facts.raw_functions}
        for name, _type in _UNDECLARED_PARAM_RE.findall(body):
            pass
        for match in re.finditer(
            r"(?m)^[ \t]*(?:unsigned[ \t]+|signed[ \t]+)?"
            r"(?:undefined\d?|byte|char|bool|int|uint|ushort|short|long|void|code|xdata|data|size_t|word|dword)\b"
            r"[^;{}\n]*?([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*(?:\[[^\]]*\])?\s*;",
            body,
        ):
            name = match.group(1)
            if name:
                self.name_map.setdefault(name, name)
        for match in re.finditer(r"(?m)^[ \t]*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*:", body):
            self.name_map.setdefault(match.group(1), map_identifier(match.group(1))[0])
        for match in re.finditer(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\b", body):
            name = match.group(1)
            if name in _C_KEYWORDS or name in functions:
                continue
            new, changed, _origin = map_identifier(name)
            if changed:
                self.name_map[name] = new

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------- output
    def header(self) -> str:
        facts = self.facts
        stats = facts.program.stats()
        lines = [
            "/*",
            f" * firmware_clean.c - readable reconstruction of {self.source_path}",
            " *",
            " * Generated by tools/recover_firmware.py emit.  Do not edit by hand:",
            " * regenerate it from the decompiled dump instead.",
            " *",
            " * What this is",
            " * ------------",
            " * Ghidra decompiled the 27C512 EPROM image firmware/nm27c512n.hex.",
            " * That image only covers 0x8000..0xFFFF, so:",
            " *",
            " *   0x8000..0xFFFF  real code - the bytes exist and were disassembled",
            " *   0x0000..0x7FFF  NOT dumped.  Anything the decompiler printed for",
            " *                   that range is guesswork; it is marked _external.",
            f" *",
            f" * functions in the dump : {stats['functions']}",
            f" * real (non-stub) bodies: {stats['recovered']}",
            f" * bad-instruction stubs : {stats['stubs']}",
            f" * global declarations   : {stats['globals']}",
            " *",
            " * Renames are mechanical and keep the address, they do not invent",
            " * meaning: FUN_CODE_810f -> sub_810F, DAT_INTMEM_3e -> iram_3E,",
            " * DAT_EXTMEM_0c7a -> xdata_0C7A, DAT_SFR_92 -> sfr_92,",
            " * LAB_CODE_ee3f -> loc_EE3F, func_0x1eb6 -> sub_1EB6_external.",
            " * The original Ghidra spelling is kept in a comment when it changes.",
            " */",
            "",
            "#ifndef FIRMWARE_CLEAN_C",
            "#define FIRMWARE_CLEAN_C",
            "",
            "#ifdef __SDCC",
            "#include <8051.h>            /* P0..P3, TCON, TMOD, SCON, ... */",
            "#else",
            "/* Plain-C fallback: on a real 8051 these live at fixed SFR addresses",
            " * (P1 at 0x90, TCON at 0x88, ACC at 0xE0, ...).  Off-target they are",
            " * ordinary volatile cells so the file still type-checks. */",
        ]
        for sfr in ("P0", "P1", "P2", "P3", "TCON", "TMOD", "TL0", "TL1", "TH0", "TH1",
                    "SCON", "SBUF", "IE", "IP", "PSW", "ACC", "B", "SP", "DPL", "DPH",
                    "PCON", "T2CON", "RCAP2L", "RCAP2H", "TL2", "TH2", "CCON", "CMOD",
                    "CCAP0L", "CCAP0H", "CCAP1L", "CCAP1H", "CCAP2L", "CCAP2H",
                    "CCAP3L", "CCAP3H", "CCAP4L", "CCAP4H", "CCAPM0", "CCAPM1",
                    "CCAPM2", "CCAPM3", "CCAPM4", "WDTRST"):
            lines.append(f"volatile unsigned char {sfr};")
        lines += [
            "#endif",
            "",
        ]
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def sfr_bits(self) -> str:
        lines = [
            "/* Bit-addressable SFR cells.  The dump reads them as e.g. P1_3 and",
            " * also declares some as the mangled bit names 22.1 etc. */",
            "#ifdef __SDCC",
        ]
        bits = sorted(
            {
                m.group(0)
                for body in [f.body for f in self.facts.program.functions]
                + [r.body for r in self.facts.raw_only]
                for m in re.finditer(r"\b(P[0-3]_[0-7]|F8_[0-7]|IP_[0-7]|FIFLG_[0-7]|HIFLG_[0-7])\b", body)
            }
        )
        for name in bits:
            port, _, bit = name.partition("_")
            if port.startswith("P") and len(port) == 2:
                lines.append(f"#define {name} {port}_{bit}")
            else:
                lines.append(f"/* {name}: bit {bit} of an unnamed SFR */")
        lines += [
            "#else",
        ]
        for name in bits:
            lines.append(f"volatile unsigned char * const {name} = (volatile unsigned char *)0;")
        lines += [
            "#endif",
            "",
        ]
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def macros(self) -> str:
        lines = [
            "/* ---- decompiler intrinsics ---------------------------------------- */",
            "/* Ghidra prints these as if they were functions; they are pure bit",
            " * arithmetic and each one is defined exactly once here. */",
            "",
        ]
        names = sorted(self.facts.intrinsic_uses, key=lambda n: (-self.facts.intrinsic_uses[n], n))
        for name in names:
            lines.append(_macro_for_intrinsic(name))
        lines += [
            "",
            "/* Ghidra emits halt_baddata() where the bytes could not be decoded.",
            " * Those bytes were never valid code; failing loudly beats returning",
            " * a value that was never in the ROM. */",
            "static void __baddata(void) {",
            "  /* ROM bytes here are not valid code */",
            "  for (;;) {",
            "  }",
            "}",
            "",
            "static void __nop(void) {}",
            "",
        ]
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def globals_block(self) -> str:
        lines = [
            "/* ---- globals ------------------------------------------------------- */",
            "/* Each name says which 8051 space it lives in:",
            " *   iram_XX   internal RAM (direct/indirect, 256 bytes)",
            " *   xdata_XXXX external data memory reached by MOVX - the cash",
            " *              register's 8255 PPI and display live here",
            " *   sfr_XX    a special function register the decompiler did not name",
            " *   rom_XXXX  a byte in code space",
            " *   bit_XX_Y  bit Y of internal RAM byte XX (Ghidra prints 22.1)",
            " */",
            "",
        ]
        for decl in self.facts.program.globals:
            if decl.type == "typedef":
                continue
            lines.append(_c_declaration(decl, self.name_map))
        extra = sorted(self.undefined_globals)
        if extra:
            lines += [
                "",
                "/* Referenced by recovered code but not declared in the dump; the",
                " * decompiler left these to the linker.  Width is unknown. */",
            ]
            for name in extra:
                lines.append(f"unsigned char {self.undefined_globals[name]};   /* was {name} */")
        lines.append("")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def body_of(self, func: Function) -> str:
        return rewrite_identifiers(pretty_body(func.body), self.name_map)

    def emit(self) -> str:
        facts = self.facts
        self._collect()
        for name in sorted(self.label_names | {
            map_identifier(m.group(1))[0]
            for body in [f.body for f in facts.program.functions] + [r.body for r in facts.raw_only]
            for m in re.finditer(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\b", body)
            if name_re_matches(m.group(1))
        }):
            pass
        self._collect_undefined_globals()

        parts: List[str] = [self.header(), self.sfr_bits(), self.macros(), self.globals_block()]

        # forward declarations
        decls: List[str] = [
            "/* ---- forward declarations ------------------------------------------ */",
        ]
        for func in facts.program.functions:
            new = self.name_map.get(func.name, map_identifier(func.name)[0])
            if func.name.startswith("thunk_"):
                continue
            ret = TYPE_MAP.get(func.return_type, func.return_type)
            params = ", ".join(
                rewrite_identifiers(p, self.name_map) for p in func.params
            )
            decls.append(f"{ret} {new}({params if params else 'void'});")
        for raw in facts.raw_only:
            new = self.name_map.get(raw.name, map_identifier(raw.name)[0])
            ret = TYPE_MAP.get(raw.return_type, raw.return_type)
            params = rewrite_identifiers(raw.params, self.name_map)
            # keep parameter names, drop initialisers
            cleaned = []
            for param in params.split(","):
                param = param.strip()
                if not param:
                    continue
                param = re.sub(r"\s*=.*$", "", param)
                cleaned.append(param)
            decls.append(f"{ret} {new}({', '.join(cleaned) if cleaned else 'void'});")
        declared_callees = set()
        for callee in sorted(facts.uncovered_calls):
            args = _arg_count(facts, callee)
            new = self.name_map.get(callee, map_identifier(callee)[0])
            if new in declared_callees:
                continue
            declared_callees.add(new)
            arglist = ", ".join(f"unsigned int a{i + 1}" for i in range(args))
            decls.append(f"unsigned int {new}({arglist if arglist else 'void'});")
        decls.append("")
        parts.append("\n".join(decls))

        # functions
        for func in facts.program.functions:
            parts.append(self._function_block(func))
        if facts.raw_only:
            parts.append(
                "/* ---- functions that recover.parse's layout heuristic skips ---------\n"
                " * These four have a pointer return type (``byte * FUN_CODE_xxxx``),\n"
                " * which the original splitter does not recognise.  Their bodies are\n"
                " * sliced straight out of the dump, so they are real code. */\n"
            )
            for raw in facts.raw_only:
                parts.append(self._raw_function_block(raw))

        # unfilled externals
        if facts.uncovered_calls:
            parts.append(self._externals_block())

        parts.append("#endif /* FIRMWARE_CLEAN_C */\n")
        return "\n".join(parts)

    def _collect_undefined_globals(self) -> None:
        """Find identifiers used in code that no declaration covers."""
        facts = self.facts
        declared = {
            map_identifier(d.name)[0]
            for d in facts.program.globals
            if d.name
        }
        declared |= {map_identifier(f.name)[0] for f in facts.program.functions}
        declared |= {map_identifier(r.name)[0] for r in facts.raw_functions}
        declared |= set(facts.parsed_names)
        declared |= {self.name_map.get(c, map_identifier(c)[0]) for c in facts.uncovered_calls}
        for func in facts.program.functions:
            for name, _t in _local_declarations(func.body):
                declared.add(name)
        for raw in facts.raw_only:
            for name, _t in _local_declarations(raw.body):
                declared.add(name)
        for name in ("param_1",):
            declared.add(name)

        for body in [f.body for f in facts.program.functions] + [r.body for r in facts.raw_only]:
            for match in re.finditer(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\b", body):
                name = match.group(1)
                if name in _C_KEYWORDS or name in declared:
                    continue
                if _is_label_like(name):
                    continue
                if re.fullmatch(r"in_[A-Za-z_]\w*", name):
                    continue
                if name in INTRINSIC_ARITY or INTRINSIC_RE.fullmatch(name):
                    continue
                new = rewrite_identifiers(name, self.name_map)
                if re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z_]\w*", new):
                    self.undefined_globals.setdefault(name, new)

    def _function_block(self, func: Function) -> str:
        new_name = self.name_map.get(func.name, map_identifier(func.name)[0])
        signature, notes = _c_signature(func, self.name_map)
        signature = signature.replace(func.name, new_name, 1)
        if new_name != signature.split("(")[0].split()[-1]:
            signature = signature.replace(signature.split("(")[0].split()[-1], new_name)
        address = f"0x{func.address:04X}" if func.address is not None else "unknown address"
        status = "stub - these bytes were never valid code" if func.is_stub else "recovered"
        lines = [
            f"/* address {address} | {status} */",
        ]
        if func.warnings:
            lines.append("/* Ghidra warnings:")
            for warning in func.warnings[:6]:
                lines.append(f" *   {warning}")
            lines.append(" */")
        if func.name.startswith("thunk_"):
            lines.append(
                f"/* thunk_FUN_CODE_* : Ghidra emitted this wrapper more than once; the\n"
                f" * variant below is kept, this name is an alias of {new_name}. */"
            )
            return "\n".join(lines) + f"\n/* {new_name} is an alias - see the same address below */\n"
        lines.append(f"{signature}")
        lines.append("{")
        body = self.body_of(func)
        if body.strip():
            lines.append(body)
        else:
            lines.append("  /* empty body */")
        lines.append("}")
        lines.append("")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _raw_function_block(self, raw: RawFunction) -> str:
        new_name = self.name_map.get(raw.name, map_identifier(raw.name)[0])
        ret = TYPE_MAP.get(raw.return_type, raw.return_type)
        params = rewrite_identifiers(raw.params, self.name_map)
        address = f"0x{raw.address:04X}" if raw.address is not None else "unknown address"
        body = rewrite_identifiers(pretty_body(raw.body), self.name_map)
        return "\n".join(
            [
                f"/* address {address} | recovered (pointer-returning signature) */",
                "/* original signature: %s %s(%s) */" % (raw.return_type, raw.name, raw.params),
                f"{ret} {new_name}({params})",
                "{",
                body if body.strip() else "  /* empty body */",
                "}",
                "",
            ]
        )

    def _externals_block(self) -> str:
        facts = self.facts
        lines = [
            "/* ---- routines outside the dump --------------------------------------",
            " * The decompiler resolved these call targets to addresses that",
            " * firmware/nm27c512n.hex does NOT cover (the image starts at 0x8000).",
            " * They live in the other half of the firmware.  Stubbed here so the",
            " * file type-checks; the bodies are NOT real and must not be trusted.",
            " */",
            "",
        ]
        for callee in sorted(facts.uncovered_calls):
            new = self.name_map.get(callee, map_identifier(callee)[0])
            args = _arg_count(facts, callee)
            arglist = ", ".join(f"unsigned int a{i + 1}" for i in range(args))
            if callee.startswith("func_0x"):
                addr = int(callee[len("func_0x"):], 16)
                note = (
                    f"/* was {callee}: address 0x{addr:04X} is not covered by any dump "
                    f"(calls: {facts.uncovered_calls[callee]}) */"
                )
            else:
                note = (
                    f"/* was {callee}: not defined anywhere in the dump "
                    f"(calls: {facts.uncovered_calls[callee]}) */"
                )
            lines.append(note)
            lines.append(f"unsigned int {new}({arglist if arglist else 'void'})")
            lines.append("{")
            lines.append("  return 0;   /* placeholder - no real firmware at this address */")
            lines.append("}")
            lines.append("")
        return "\n".join(lines)


def _local_declarations(body: str) -> List[Tuple[str, str]]:
    """Local variable declarations inside a function body."""
    found: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
    for match in re.finditer(
        r"(?m)^[ \t]*(?:unsigned[ \t]+|signed[ \t]+)?"
        r"(?P<type>undefined\d?|byte|char|bool|int|uint|ushort|short|long|void|code|xdata|data|size_t|word|dword)\b"
        r"[^;{}\n]*?(?P<name>[A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*(?:\[[^\]]*\])?\s*;",
        body,
    ):
        found.append((match.group("name"), match.group("type")))
    return found


def _is_label_like(name: str) -> bool:
    return bool(re.match(r"^(LAB_CODE_|code_c0x)", name))


def name_re_matches(name: str) -> bool:
    """True when :func:`map_identifier` would rename ``name``."""
    return map_identifier(name)[1]


def emit_c(
    text: str,
    source_name: str = "",
    covered: Sequence[Tuple[int, int]] = ((DUMP_ROM_START, DUMP_ROM_END),),
) -> EmitResult:
    """Build the readable C reconstruction."""
    facts = _analyse(text, source_name, covered)
    program = CProgram(facts, source_name=source_name)
    code = program.emit()
    stats = program_stats(facts, program)
    stats["balance_problems"] = check_balance(code)
    return EmitResult(path="firmware_clean.c", text=code, stats=stats, balance=stats["balance_problems"])


def program_stats(facts: DumpFacts, program: Optional[CProgram] = None) -> Dict[str, object]:
    """Counters shared by the C and Python emitters."""
    parsed = facts.program.functions
    return {
        "source": facts.source_name,
        "functions": len(parsed),
        "raw_functions": len(facts.raw_functions),
        "raw_only": len(facts.raw_only),
        "stubs": sum(1 for f in parsed if f.is_stub),
        "globals": len(facts.program.globals),
        "uncovered_calls": len(facts.uncovered_calls),
        "intrinsics": len(facts.intrinsic_uses),
        "missing_ranges": missing_ranges(facts.covered),
    }


# --------------------------------------------------------------- Python emitter
@dataclass
class RecoveredEntry:
    """One ``RECOVERED`` entry in ``firmware_recovered.py``."""

    name: str
    original_name: str
    address: Optional[int]
    params: List[str]
    source_body: str
    translated_ops: int
    status: str
    reason: str = ""
    callees: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_literal(self, indent: str = "    ") -> str:
        callees = ", ".join(repr(c) for c in self.callees)
        params = ", ".join(repr(p) for p in self.params)
        lines = [
            f"{indent}{self.name!r}: {{",
            f"{indent}    \"name\": {self.name!r},",
            f"{indent}    \"original_name\": {self.original_name!r},",
            f"{indent}    \"address\": {self.address if self.address is not None else 'None'},",
            f"{indent}    \"params\": [{params}],",
            f"{indent}    \"translated_ops\": {self.translated_ops},",
            f"{indent}    \"status\": {self.status!r},",
        ]
        if self.reason:
            lines.append(f"{indent}    \"reason\": {self.reason!r},")
        if self.callees:
            lines.append(f"{indent}    \"callees\": [{callees}],")
        lines.append(f"{indent}    \"source_body\": {self.source_body!r},")
        lines.append(f"{indent}}},")
        return "\n".join(lines)


def _count_ops(body: str) -> int:
    """Statement/expression count of a body (a cheap 'translated ops' metric)."""
    tokens = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z_]\w*|\d+|[^\sA-Za-z_0-9]", body)
    return sum(1 for t in tokens if t not in ("{", "}", ";", ",", "(", ")", " "))
    return len(tokens)


def _status_of(func: Function, parsed_ok: Optional[bool], reason: str) -> str:
    if func.is_stub:
        return "stub"
    if parsed_ok is False:
        return "unparseable"
    if any("Truncating control flow" in w for w in func.warnings) or "truncat" in (reason or "").lower():
        return "truncated"
    return "ok"


def emit_python(
    text: str,
    source_name: str = "",
    covered: Sequence[Tuple[int, int]] = ((DUMP_ROM_START, DUMP_ROM_END),),
) -> EmitResult:
    """Build the machine-readable Python mirror of the dump."""
    from .cparse import ParseError, parse_body

    facts = _analyse(text, source_name, covered)
    entries: Dict[str, RecoveredEntry] = {}
    ratio_ok = 0
    ratio_total = 0

    for func in facts.program.functions:
        new_name, _changed, _origin = map_identifier(func.name)
        reason = ""
        parsed_ok: Optional[bool] = None
        if func.is_stub:
            parsed_ok = True
            reason = "Ghidra halted on bytes that are not valid code"
        else:
            ratio_total += 1
            try:
                parse_body(func.body)
                parsed_ok = True
                ratio_ok += 1
            except (ParseError, ValueError, RecursionError) as exc:
                parsed_ok = False
                reason = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
        body = pretty_body(func.body)
        callees = sorted(set(_CALL_RE.findall(body)) - _C_KEYWORDS)
        entries[new_name] = RecoveredEntry(
            name=new_name,
            original_name=func.name,
            address=func.address,
            params=[rewrite_identifiers(p, {}) for p in func.params],
            source_body=body,
            translated_ops=_count_ops(body),
            status=_status_of(func, parsed_ok, reason),
            reason=reason,
            callees=callees,
        )

    for raw in facts.raw_only:
        new_name, _changed, _origin = map_identifier(raw.name)
        body = pretty_body(raw.body)
        entries[new_name] = RecoveredEntry(
            name=new_name,
            original_name=raw.name,
            address=raw.address,
            params=[p.strip() for p in raw.params.split(",") if p.strip()],
            source_body=body,
            translated_ops=_count_ops(body),
            status="ok",
            reason="found by emit's text scan (pointer-returning signature)",
            callees=sorted(set(_CALL_RE.findall(body)) - _C_KEYWORDS),
        )

    lines: List[str] = [
        '"""Machine-readable mirror of the recovered firmware.',
        "",
        f"Generated by tools/recover_firmware.py emit from {source_name or '(stdin)'}.",
        "Do not edit by hand; regenerate instead.",
        "",
        "Status values",
        "-------------",
        "ok           body parses and is backed by bytes at 0x8000..0xFFFF",
        "stub         Ghidra could not decode the bytes (halt_baddata)",
        "truncated    control flow was cut short by the decompiler",
        "unparseable  recover.cparse rejected the body; see ``reason``",
        "",
        "``RECOVERED`` keys are the readable names emitted into firmware_clean.c;",
        "``original_name`` is the identifier as it appears in the Ghidra dump.",
        '"""',
        "",
        f"SOURCE = {source_name!r}",
        f"DUMP_ROM = ({DUMP_ROM_START:#06x}, {DUMP_ROM_END:#06x})",
        "",
        "#: Ranges no dump covers.  Code below 0x8000 is decompiler guesswork.",
        f"MISSING_RANGES = {missing_ranges(facts.covered)!r}",
        "",
        "#: Call targets outside every dump: name -> (address or None, call count)",
        "UNCOVERED_CALLS = {",
    ]
    for callee, count in sorted(facts.uncovered_calls.items()):
        if callee.startswith("func_0x"):
            addr = int(callee[len("func_0x"):], 16)
            lines.append(f"    {callee!r}: ({addr:#06x}, {count}),")
        else:
            lines.append(f"    {callee!r}: (None, {count}),")
    lines += [
        "}",
        "",
        "STATS = {",
        f"    \"functions\": {len(entries)},",
        f"    \"recovered\": {sum(1 for e in entries.values() if e.status == 'ok')},",
        f"    \"stubs\": {sum(1 for e in entries.values() if e.status == 'stub')},",
        f"    \"truncated\": {sum(1 for e in entries.values() if e.status == 'truncated')},",
        f"    \"unparseable\": {sum(1 for e in entries.values() if e.status == 'unparseable')},",
        f"    \"raw_scan_only\": {len(facts.raw_only)},",
        f"    \"globals\": {len(facts.program.globals)},",
        f"    \"uncovered_calls\": {len(facts.uncovered_calls)},",
        f"    \"body_parse_ratio\": ({ratio_ok}, {ratio_total}),",
        "}",
        "",
        "RECOVERED = {",
    ]
    for name in sorted(entries):
        lines.append(entries[name].to_literal())
    lines += [
        "}",
        "",
        "",
        "def by_address():",
        '    """address -> entry, for the functions whose address is known."""',
        "    return {e[\"address\"]: e for e in RECOVERED.values() if e[\"address\"] is not None}",
        "",
        "",
        "def stubs():",
        '    """Functions the decompiler could not decode."""',
        "    return sorted(n for n, e in RECOVERED.items() if e[\"status\"] == \"stub\")",
        "",
        "",
        "if __name__ == \"__main__\":",
        "    import json",
        "    print(json.dumps(STATS, indent=2, sort_keys=True))",
        "    print(\"missing ranges:\", MISSING_RANGES)",
        "",
    ]
    code = "\n".join(lines)
    stats = program_stats(facts)
    stats.update(
        {
            "entries": len(entries),
            "ok": sum(1 for e in entries.values() if e.status == "ok"),
            "stubs": sum(1 for e in entries.values() if e.status == "stub"),
            "unparseable": sum(1 for e in entries.values() if e.status == "unparseable"),
            "body_parse_ratio": [ratio_ok, ratio_total],
        }
    )
    return EmitResult(path="firmware_recovered.py", text=code, stats=stats)


def emit_all(
    text: str,
    source_name: str = "",
    covered: Sequence[Tuple[int, int]] = ((DUMP_ROM_START, DUMP_ROM_END),),
) -> Tuple[EmitResult, EmitResult]:
    """Build both artifacts without touching the filesystem."""
    return emit_c(text, source_name, covered), emit_python(text, source_name, covered)
